The '''Calico Statue''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that can be purchased on [[Spring|Spring 15]] or [[Spring|Spring 17]] from the [[Desert Festival#Calico Egg Merchant|Calico Egg Merchant]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|25|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s or {{Price|35|Calico}} Calico Eggs, respectively. It may be placed anywhere, indoors or out.
